receipt_architecture.required_order: Prepare bounded canonical payload; exclusive descriptor-relative staging write; flush and fsync staged file successfully; only then publish canonical receipt without overwriting. No post-serialization flag mutation as evidence.
receipt_architecture.authority: Unpublished staging bytes are not a terminal receipt and must be rejected as authoritative by consumers. Persist failures preserve non-authoritative partial artifacts; canonical success must be absent when staging write/flush/fsync fails.
receipt_architecture.publication: Use a supported no-overwrite publication primitive with pinned parent handles. Account for every retained staging/final directory entry and bytes inside unchanged caps. Do not silently fall back to overwriting rename or unprotected absolute writes.
receipt_architecture.durability_limit: File fsync and successful no-overwrite publication do not prove crash durability of the parent directory. State that limit explicitly; no new crash-survival/product PASS claim. Do not perform another fallible validation after publication and then leave a success-looking canonical receipt while returning failure.
receipt_architecture.scope: Internal harness persistence/validation contract correction only; original frozen packet and historical receipts remain immutable. If safe publication cannot be implemented within current owner, ask root before changing another owner.

evidence_architecture.source: Shared QD/QS validators require exact typed descriptor identity, positive bounded size/hash, and bound source path matching run root/input reference and original identity. Missing/null/malformed evidence is unknown.
evidence_architecture.release: Persist bounded actual release_preload proof rather than two favorable booleans or a sample count: proven, loaded_models=0 (strict int), actual 3..32 GPU sample list, elapsed<=30s, bound baseline, monotone cadence and last-three baseline+1024. Reuse same pure validator in QD and QS. No new sampler/model calls.
evidence_architecture.flags: QD explicitly emits receipt and every-row storage_unproven and cleanup_unproven booleans. QS requires literal False for complete evidence; absent/null/wrong type never defaults to success.
evidence_architecture.known_failures: Complete verified known failure remains resolved/not usable; verified critical evidence remains visible independently; 8/10 images,5/6 videos,score>=8 and globalcritical0 unchanged.

send_boundary_architecture.guard: One final local send-admission guard after all controlled prep/authorization/source work: original ownership, monotone phase clock/deadline, exact typed parent proof identity/interval/capacity, then local 1/4 reservation and attempt charge immediately before submit without another unchecked callback.
send_boundary_architecture.capacity: Require sufficient current proof capacity and remaining bounded allocation at each send; cumulative local reservation never exceeds admitted capacity or34. No refund/retry on failed or unknown submit. Expiry or diminution before first send produces zero sends and all16 refused; later refusal retains all prior attempts.
send_boundary_architecture.parent: Authentic original-ledger reservation/debit and preemptive parent supervision remain required future integration; no new ledger API or timeout thread.
